about: Made-up matching test cases: no real people. Answers are in question order (src/lib/matching/questions.js); mentors answer questions 1 and 6 in the mentor wording. Each student has the result we WANT: the mentor who should come first, or "coordinator". Students in the same group say the same thing in different writing styles, so they should get the same result. Checks on the summaries (any profile): mustKeep: phrases that must survive in that question's likes. mustNotMention: words that must not appear in any of the likes (things they ruled out). mustAvoid: phrases that must appear in that question's avoids. mustNotAvoid: words that must not appear in any avoids (styles such as partying or nights out, and people, faith and so on). noAvoids: questions whose avoids must be empty. styles: the styles the profile must get, where null means they don't say so it must be "not said"; styles not listed aren't checked.
